name: Eva Skin Clinic Vitamin C Serum
description: A 15% vitamin C serum from Eva's dermatology line, made for Egyptian weather and sun exposure. It fades dark spots and post-acne marks over four to six weeks without the sting of stronger acids.

name: Eva Collagen Day Cream SPF 15
description: A light collagen day cream with built-in SPF 15. It sits well under makeup, absorbs in seconds and keeps skin comfortable through a long day in Cairo humidity.

name: Nefertari Argan & Almond Body Oil
description: Cold-pressed argan blended with sweet almond oil, bottled in Nefertari's workshop. Sinks in without a greasy film and leaves a soft, warm scent that lasts.

name: Imtenan Black Seed Face Oil
description: Pure Egyptian black seed oil, pressed and bottled by Imtenan. A few drops at night calm redness and strengthen a stressed moisture barrier.

name: Eva Sun Protection SPF 50
description: A high-protection sunscreen that finishes matte and never turns white. Reef-safe filters, sweat resistant, and formulated to suit medium to deep skin tones.

name: Harraz Damask Rose Water Toner
description: Single-distilled damask rose water from Harraz, the old Cairo herbalist. No alcohol, no fragrance added — just a calm, hydrating step before your serum.

name: Amoun Ceramide Repair Cream
description: A cushiony barrier cream built on a ceramide complex from Amoun's dermatology range. Fragrance free and gentle enough for reactive, post-treatment skin.

name: Eva Aloe & Cucumber Cleansing Gel
description: A daily gel cleanser with aloe and cucumber extract that lifts sunscreen and city dust without stripping. Leaves skin comfortable, never tight.

name: Eva Velvet Matte Lipstick
description: A creamy matte bullet with dense pigment — one clean pass is enough. The formula stays put through tea and never settles into lip lines.

name: Eva Perfect Cover Foundation
description: A buildable medium-coverage foundation in twenty shades matched to Egyptian skin tones. The satin finish blurs texture while still reading like real skin.

name: Eva Volume Lash Mascara
description: A tapered brush that separates as it builds. Holds a curl through a full day and comes off with warm water, no tugging at the lash line.

name: Harraz Kohl Eyeliner Pencil
description: Traditional Egyptian kohl in a modern twist-up pencil. Deep matte black, glides on without dragging, and stays sharp through the day.

name: Eva Silk Compact Powder
description: A finely milled pressed powder that controls shine through humidity without flattening the face. Comes with a mirror and a proper puff.

name: Eva Cheek Glow Blush Duo
description: Two coordinated shades — a soft flush and a warm highlight — in one compact. Blends with a fingertip and layers without going patchy.

name: Sekem Jasmine Absolute Perfume Oil
description: Egyptian jasmine grown on Sekem's biodynamic farms and captured as a concentrated oil. Warm, honeyed and long-lasting — a little on the wrist is plenty.

name: Harraz Musk El Tahara Roll-On
description: The classic white musk Egyptian households have used for generations, in a practical roll-on. Clean, powdery and gentle enough for daily wear.

name: Sekem Egyptian Geranium Eau de Toilette
description: Geranium and bergamot from organic Egyptian fields, lifted with a clean musk. Light enough for the office and for hot weather.

name: Nefertari Amber & Oud Perfume Oil
description: A smoky amber built on oud and a thread of vanilla, blended in small batches. Made for cool evenings, and it leaves a trail people ask about.

name: Imtenan Lotus Blossom Body Mist
description: An alcohol-light mist scented with Egyptian lotus and a touch of neroli. Refreshing rather than heavy, and kind to hair and skin.

name: Harraz Sandalwood & Rose Attar
description: A traditional attar of Indian sandalwood laid under Egyptian rose. Alcohol free, deeply warm, and it develops differently on every skin.

name: Eva Daily Glow Ritual Set
description: The aloe cleansing gel, vitamin C serum and collagen day cream in full size, boxed together. Everything needed for a complete morning routine, at a saving.

name: Nefertari Hammam Gift Box
description: A traditional Egyptian bath ritual in one box: olive oil soap, a loofah mitt, argan body oil and a small jar of Dead Sea salt scrub.

name: Harraz Attar Discovery Collection
description: Five ten-millilitre attars covering the full Harraz range — musk, rose, sandalwood, jasmine and amber — with a voucher toward a full bottle.

name: Eva Everyday Face Edit
description: A curated makeup set with the cover foundation, cheek glow duo and a velvet matte lipstick in a universally flattering rose. Packs flat for travel.

name: Imtenan Pure Oils Trio
description: Black seed, argan and jojoba oils in matched amber bottles, cold pressed and unblended. The three oils that cover face, body and hair.

name: Eva Bridal Luminous Collection
description: A six-piece set built for long wear under photography, from primer through setting powder. Presented in a keepsake blush lacquer case.

name: Shaan Sun Shield SPF 50
description: A high-protection sunscreen from Shaan that shields against UVA and UVB without the white cast. Light enough to layer under makeup and made for long Egyptian summers.

name: Shaan Rejuvenation Cream
description: A rich night cream that gives long-lasting hydration and supports collagen production. Formulated for dry and very dry skin that needs more than a light moisturiser.

name: Shaan Antioxidant Facial Cleanser
description: A gentle antioxidant cleanser made for sensitive skin. Lifts sunscreen and pollution without stripping, and leaves nothing tight behind.

name: Shaan Hydrating Micellar Water
description: A micellar makeup remover that takes off even waterproof formulas in one pass. No rinsing needed and no sting around the eyes.

name: Shaan Medicated Lip Balm
description: Pure vaseline and glycerin in a nourishing balm that repairs chapped lips overnight. Unscented, and safe to reapply as often as you like.

name: Shaan Nail Repair Serum
description: A treatment serum with biotin, hyaluronic acid, marine collagen and a UV filter. Strengthens peeling nails over a few weeks of nightly use.

name: Bubblzz Shea Body Butter
description: A whipped shea and cocoa butter made from scratch in small batches. Sinks in properly instead of sitting on top, and the scent stays soft all day.

name: Bubblzz Coffee Body Scrub
description: Ground Egyptian coffee blended with sugar and essential oils. Buffs away dryness without scratching, and rinses clean with no greasy film.

name: Bubblzz Handmade Olive Soap Bar
description: A cold-process olive oil soap, cured for six weeks and free from harsh detergents. Gentle enough for the face and kind to eczema-prone skin.

name: Bubblzz Natural Deodorant Balm
description: An aluminium-free deodorant balm built on arrowroot and essential oils. Holds through a full Cairo day without blocking pores or staining shirts.

name: Bubblzz Vanilla & Musk Body Mist
description: A light body mist with warm vanilla over clean musk, made from organic and essential oils. Soft enough to layer over your usual perfume.

name: Caroline Beauty Custom Match Foundation
description: A buildable foundation shade-matched to Egyptian skin tones, from the brand known for its custom-blending service. Satin finish that photographs beautifully.

name: Caroline Beauty Signature Matte Lipstick
description: A soft-matte bullet with dense pigment in one pass. The shade range runs from everyday nudes to the deep reds Egyptian brides ask for.

name: Dorella Brow Styling Soap
description: The brow soap that made Dorella a household name. Brushes brows up and holds them there all day, with no crunch and no flaking.

name: Dorella Shimmer Highlighter
description: A pressed highlighter milled fine enough to glow rather than glitter. Works on the high points of the face or pressed over cream blush.

name: Karmel Beauty Lip & Cheek Tint
description: One tint for lips and cheeks, buildable from a wash of colour to a full flush. Weightless, and it does not dry the lips out.

name: Karmel Beauty Precision Lip Liner
description: A creamy liner that glides without dragging and stays put under gloss. Sharpens to a fine point for a clean edge.

name: Grazel Bold Eyeshadow Palette
description: Twelve high-pigment shades — warm neutrals through to the bold colours Grazel is known for. Blends easily and costs a fraction of the imports.

name: Glaze by KG Hydrating Lip Gloss
description: A non-sticky gloss that genuinely moisturises, with a mirror shine over any lipstick. Comfortable enough to wear on bare lips.

name: Mala Beauty Vegan Volume Mascara
description: A vegan, dermatologist-approved mascara made for sensitive eyes and contact lens wearers. Builds volume without clumping or flaking.

name: Egyptian Makeup Starter Kit
description: Five local heroes in one box: the Caroline matte lipstick, Dorella brow soap, Karmel lip and cheek tint, Glaze gloss and a Grazel mini palette.

name: Bubblzz Bath Ritual Box
description: The olive soap, coffee scrub, shea body butter and vanilla body mist boxed together with a loofah mitt. A full bath ritual at a saving.
